card.name: Second word of fixed dosing phrases
card.fires_on: The key word that completes a stock phrase in dosing text, such as "divided doses", "as tolerated", "at steady state" and "body surface area". It also fires on "stirring" in "cook, stirring constantly" in recipes.

modes.label: Dosing phrases
modes.description: A word inside a set dosing or pharmacokinetic phrase, like divided, steady or tolerated.
modes.example: increase the dose of ZELBORAF by 240 mg (one tablet) as<< tolerated>>. After discontinuation

modes.label: Other stock phrases
modes.description: A word in a fixed phrase outside dosing, such as stirring in recipes or confidence in statistics.
modes.example: Add flour and cook,<< stirring>> constantly, until no dry flour remains,
